# A New Opinion Is True as It Satisfies Our Double Urgency

A new opinion counts as 'true' just in proportion as it gratifies the individual's desire to assimilate the novel in his experience to his beliefs in stock.[^1] It must both lean on old truth and grasp new fact; and its success[^2] in doing this, is a matter for the individual's appreciation.[^3] When old truth grows, then, by new truth's addition, it is for subjective reasons.[^4] We are in the process and obey the reasons.[^5] That new idea is truest which performs most felicitously its function of satisfying our double urgency.[^6] It makes itself true, gets itself classed as true, by the way it works; grafting itself then upon the ancient body of truth, which thus grows much as a tree grows by the activity of a new layer of cambium.[^7]
